outputs.summary: On Windows and Linux the app window no longer shows the File/Edit/View/Window menu bar: once Electron is ready, startup calls Menu.setApplicationMenu(null) before creating the main window (via a pure helper removeWindowMenuBar in src/main/windowPolicy.ts). macOS keeps Electron's default menu deliberately: it lives in the system menu bar, not the window, and carries Cmd+C/V/X/A and Cmd+Q. Side effect on Windows/Linux: default menu accelerators (Ctrl+R reload, Ctrl+Shift+I DevTools, zoom, F11, Ctrl+W) are gone; nothing in the app relies on them. Text-field copy/paste still works (handled by Chromium). Commit is local, not pushed.
